name: docs
description: B2B platform documentation site — Docusaurus. Authored for both developers and Product Owners per the constitution's Documentation Requirements.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter backend run docs:collect && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/@docusaurus/core/bin/docusaurus.mjs start
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend run docs:collect && docusaurus build
scripts.lint: echo 'docs site has no linter job'
